approval_and_launch: Root must review and publish this prospective source packet, use a published exact source commit, and explicitly invoke execute. This preparation task makes no provider calls and reads no provider credential.

budget.scope: Reported compute rates and targeted cleanup duration only; no measured total invoice, storage/network guarantee, provider TTL, or guarantee during API outage.

change: One final GPU provisioning continuation. No separate CPU pod. Explicit capacity refusals may try the next preferred GPU; the first actual or ambiguous creation ends all further create attempts.
cleanup: Pre-POST detached watchdog binds a random exact name AND fresh nonce; successful create binds an exact owned ID. Both controller and independent watchdog request exact-ID deletion and verify 404. Ambiguous creation is reconciled by fresh name AND nonce and never followed by another create. No unrelated pod is adopted or modified.

evidence.overwrite_policy: Exact final output directory must not already exist. Existing local old failed-host evidence is never the extraction destination.
evidence.verification: Authenticated archive byte count and SHA-256, restricted member namespace/types, no duplicate/traversal/link members, full independent member SHA-256 and exact manifest coverage.

observed_prior_state.earlier_host: Native GPU arithmetic controls passed; old strict ingestion rejected valid zero-length reports; replacement checker is already frozen in payload-v5
observed_prior_state.high_RAM_CPU: Both v1 and v2 exact high-memory requests refused; no fifth pod was allocated
observed_prior_state.latest_host: CUDA device enumeration failed with unknown error; provider reported reboot recovery

GPU_gates: short walk and corrected v2 ingestion
two bounded 180-second challenge continuations and independent ingestion
scientific_scope.claims: A failed gate remains a failed measurement. Passing bounded controls is not completion of ECC2K-130, a cryptanalytic speedup, or a recovered logarithm. Overall workflow may be nonzero solely because the independent frontier guard refuses insufficient RAM.
scientific_scope.unchanged_additional_controls: Fixed launcher also retains negation controls and its optional high-memory frontier gate. No new CPU pod is requested; a frontier refusal is kept separate from GPU gate outcomes.

source.public_delivery_proof: Execute requires an unauthenticated exact-byte/hash download from an explicit public 40-hex source commit before reading the provider key or making any provider operation.
